title: Chapter 374
text:
A blazing beam of light burst out like a golden spear piercing through the darkness and exploded on Ashes' face!

Boom!

Flames burst out!

Before the scattered light had even dissipated, a human figure dashed out. Han Xiao's reaction was extremely fast. The handle of the scythe popped out from his vambrace and slid into his palm. He swung it in a half-moon shape and expanded it into a huge black scythe.

The scythe and the figure clashed.

Clang!

Sparks flew in all directions, and the sound of metal clashing rang out!

A translucent hand grabbed the scythe, and the two sides clashed. The sound of friction could be heard.

Han Xiao took a closer look. Ashes' skin had turned into a diamond-like state. Sharp blades could not cut through it — it was extremely hard.

The ground under his feet moved, and the carbon elements were separated and turned into dust particles. They wrapped around his legs like a tornado and quickly hardened.

Han Xiao was shocked. He jumped back hurriedly and dodged before the soil hardened. He tore apart the diamond that had yet to form.

Control of carbon elements? What a troublesome ability … The mechanical suit's analyzer detected the composition of the controlled substances. They were all made of carbon. Han Xiao was very experienced and immediately guessed the opponent's ability. He felt that it was troublesome.

This kind of ability to control atoms was very rare. Its effect was usually very comprehensive. It could attack, defend, control, and even create materials. Many natural substances contained carbon elements, and the opponent's ability was the nemesis of carbon-based monkeys.

Han Xiao was shocked. Luckily, he had a talent that was immune to True Damage. Otherwise, he would have died.

[Steel Body] came from the leader of the Germinal Organization. Of course, with his current knowledge, the leader's strength was not enough. However, that old guy was still a main character and a boss. This talent was a Molding Talent, and its effect was very strong. You can hit me, you can hit me, but don't even think about dealing True Damage. One had to know that True Damage ignored resistance and was extremely dangerous. Even the toughest Pugilists would feel terrible if they were hit by a True Damage. With this talent, it was like having a safety net.

Until now, Han Xiao had earned a total of two Molding Talents. The other one was [Elementary Strengthened Life], which increased his health. As a Mechanic, his health was comparable to that of a Pugilist of the same level. He was so tanky that his enemies were disgusted. Anyway, Ashes was disgusted.

[Carbon Atom Deconstruction] was a new way to use his Esper Ability that Ashes had learned after breaking through to Grade B. It was a killer move against low-grade Supers. The principle was to directly destroy the molecular structure of the opponent's body. The difference in energy and level had to be determined, and only when the target failed would they receive true damage. Normally, those with a lower grade than Ashes would not be able to pass the test. However, Han Xiao was such an anomaly. Although his grade was lower, he was immune to True Damage.

"Go!"

Ashes suppressed the shock in his heart. His trump card had failed, and his other abilities were all conventional means of combat. They did not have enough killing power. Now was clearly not the time to fight, so there was no time to think.

Hum —

His Esper Field spread out, and the ground and walls rippled like water. Countless carbon elements were stripped and reshaped. The powdery particles surrounded Han Xiao like fluttering black ribbons and quickly hardened into diamonds. They were of various shapes, such as spikes, barriers, cages, and so on, entangling Han Xiao.

Crackle!

The entire field was filled with floating and spinning carbon dust. It was like waves moving up and down, turning solid from time to time. It was a spectacular sight!

Han Xiao gritted his teeth. The ribbons of dust were dense and unpredictable. They did not stop moving at all. He suddenly felt like he was in a bullet screen game. It was a test of his reflexes.

The artificial intelligence of the Amphiptere mechanical suit quickly planned a dodging route. Han Technician moved and dodged, missing by a hair's breadth every time. His movements were extremely difficult. He was like a patient with epilepsy doing a street dance with a wire hanging from his neck.

Convulsion!

However, the effect was also very obvious. It looked dangerous, but it was actually as steady as an old dog!

While Han Xiao was busy, Ashes took the Silver and escaped out of the door. Han Xiao would not let the Silver be taken away just like that. Just as he was about to chase after them, the mechanical suit suddenly alerted him that there was a high energy reaction behind him!

He dodged with a sliding step!

Boom!

All kinds of attacks landed on the spot where he was originally standing, blowing up a huge hole. Han Xiao looked back. The group of pirates had also retreated with the slaves. They raised their guns and opened fire. Dozens of Supers surrounded him murderously.

"Quick, kill the witness!"

"He's only one person. Let's go together!"

Han Xiao was immediately surrounded and could not escape. Ashes and the others disappeared from his sight. He frowned and had to deal with this group of brutes for the time being.

He was alone, and they were using their numbers to attack him. There was no way he could end the battle quickly, so Han Xiao decided to use the built-in communication device of the mechanical suit to call for help.

After fighting for a while, the group of pirates realized that they could not do anything to Han Xiao at all. A few of them were even killed by Han Xiao, so they started to get anxious.

"This guy is quite strong. Don't waste time. Let's go!"

"No, he saw our identities. If we inform the guards, we'll be exposed immediately!"

This group of brutes had different opinions. Half of them wanted to retreat. Just as they were about to retreat, the roof of the slave market suddenly exploded. Everyone was shocked and looked up in shock. A few Dragonfly Butterfly aircraft were hovering in the sky, shining down searchlights. The background was a colorful galaxy, and there were more aircraft coming from afar.

This group of guards were all players. Han Xiao called them over with a simple call. Using the convenience of his position, he quickly arrived to help. Herlous waved and greeted them through the high-density glass.

All the brutes were shocked! It was like being caught red-handed by the police!

Han Xiao stepped back and left the range of the firepower. He curled his lips.

Have you ever heard of a cloud-piercing arrow leading to the arrival of thousands of soldiers? You want to gang up on me? Burn your dreams. I have helpers too!

All the aircraft opened fire and poured lasers at the brutes.

Bang! Bang!

The golden lasers were like a rainstorm, and a large group of these pirates fell like cutting chives. They were terrified!

"It's the Dragon Guards! Run! "

"Split up!"

They panicked and did not have time to care about Han Xiao. They immediately scattered like birds and animals, covering their heads and running in all directions. The aircraft split up to chase after them.

Han Xiao did not chase after them immediately. The Dragon Guards were higher up in the sky, so their hunting efficiency was higher. He did not want to move on the ground, so he was waiting for his' Bat Wings' to arrive. Ashes was the first to escape. He was already out of sight, but Han Xiao did not just watch. He secretly marked him.

"Herlous, a group of mysterious people stole the Silvers. I marked them on the radar. I've sent the information to you. Don't let them get away!" Han Xiao outlined a glowing path on the map and sent it to Herlous. He said seriously, "They have a Super, also Grade B, who can control carbon elements. Be careful, maintain the shield. Don't fight with him before I arrive!"

"Got it. I've already seen them. I'm following them," Herlous replied.

This time, Wilsander's communication came. He asked with a deep voice, "What happened?"

Han Xiao repeated what had happened, emphasizing that the enemy had attacked Floating Dragon's assets with bad intentions, and that he was the one who had stopped the enemy. These enemies were so arrogant, daring to shit, piss, and fart on the head of the Dragon Guards. If he did not go up and kill them, he would have no shame.

He was afraid that Wilsander did not get the main point, so he repeated it three times.

"Okay, okay, I got it." Wilsander quickly hung up the communication, afraid that Han Xiao would repeat it a fourth time. However, Han Xiao had achieved his goal. Wilsander's mind kept repeating what had just happened, and he could not forget it even if he wanted to. The more he thought about it, the angrier he got.

That's right. Who doesn't know that we, the Dragon Guards, protect the entire city? These people still dare to break the rules and look down on the Dragon Guards. Are they challenging me? Today, these people dared to steal the slaves, and tomorrow, they dare to blow up the floating island. What the f * ck! If I don't kill you all, I won't be the Dragon Guards!

Wilsander pondered for a while and was furious. He ordered the Dragon Guards under him to move out.

Since Ames was not around, the Dragon Guards were on standby at all times. They were on level one alert, extremely efficient. Aircrafts flew across the sky one after another.

The residents and outsiders on the ground all raised their heads in astonishment. They had never seen such a grand scene with so many guards. What was going on?!

Han Xiao looked around at the mess. When he saw the unconscious Horlaide, his eyes lit up, and his mood instantly improved. He clicked his tongue and said, "Serves you right. You want to take my money? You'll regret it."

When Horlaide woke up and saw that all the slaves had been stolen, and his house had become clean and well-ventilated, Han Xiao wondered what kind of expression he would have. Thinking of Horlaide's smug look, he could not help but gloat.

Looking at the interface, there was a new message. It reminded him that he had discovered a criminal act, provided information, and blocked the enemy. Floating Dragon Faction Favorability increased by 400 points. Their relationship finally rose from Cold to Neutral.

Han Xiao suddenly thought of something. Taking advantage of the waiting time, he walked into the underground prison and came to the secret door. He smashed the wall with brute force, revealing Aroshia's cell.

The brutes did not notice this secret door, and Aroshia was still locked inside. In fact, Ashes had noticed the existence of the secret door, but his target was only the Silvers, so he was too lazy to tell others.

Han Xiao tore open the cell door and reached out to Aroshia.

He still remembered that he had a [Visitor from Afar] mission, and the requirement was to take Aroshia away. Because Horlaide was desperate for money, he did not buy it. Now was a good opportunity!

If he did not take advantage of the situation now, Han Technician would not be able to get over it!

He would not even leave a strand of hair for Horlaide!

Aroshia looked up and stared at Han Xiao's hand. Confusion appeared on her face, and she did not move.

"Right, she has no memory, and she is not very curious." Han Xiao thought of Horlaide's introduction, so he simply went up and unlocked her shackles and collar. He grabbed Aroshia 'hand and walked out.

As expected, Aroshia did not have any intention of resisting. Her face was calm, and she allowed Han Xiao to pull her along like a boat drifting with the current, following his every step.
